effectEntries.effect: Prevents the target from switching out. At the end of each turn, the targets Defense and Special Defense are lowered by 1 stage. The target may switch out using a Shed shell, Baton Pass, Flip turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-Turn, or Volt Switch. This effect ends if either Pokemon leave the field.
effectEntries.shortEffect: Prevents the target from switching out. At the end of each turn, the targets Defense and Special Defense are lowered by 1 stage.

descriptions.text: Das Ziel wird an der Flucht gehindert und seine Verteidigung und Spezial-Verteidigung sinken jede Runde.
The user locks the target in and prevents it from fleeing. This move also lowers the target’s Defense and Sp. Def every turn.
Retiene al objetivo para impedir su huida, a la vez que reduce su Defensa y Defensa Especial cada turno.

Le lanceur empêche l’adversaire de fuir. À chaque tour qui passe, cette capacité baisse la Défense et la Défense Spéciale de la cible.
Chi la usa immobilizza il bersaglio impedendogli di fuggire e ne diminuisce la Difesa e la Difesa Speciale a ogni turno.
